title: Claim Determination Standard — Bridgewell New Home Builder Warranties
content:
Bridgewell decides whether a claim under its New Home Builder Warranties is a covered defect under the warranty's standards. This standard governs that determination.

## The standard

**One determination.** One determination is issued per claim. Whether a claim already has its determination is read from the company's records of that claim before one is issued.

**Covered or not covered.** A claim is covered only when every condition below holds, and otherwise is not covered with the first failing reason. The conditions are taken in the order listed, and each carries the reason given when it is the first to fail.

| Order | Condition that must hold | Reason when it is the first to fail |
|---|---|---|
| 1 | The warranty was confirmed and the defect was discovered within the phase for its category, or filed within the grace after it. | Warranty not in force |
| 2 | The claim met the notice window of the claim filing rules. | Late notice |
| 3 | A drywall crack is wider than the program's drywall crack threshold, a slab crack wider or displaced more than the program's slab crack threshold, or a floor more than the program's floor out-of-level threshold out of level within any 32-inch span. | Below performance standard |
| 4 | A structural claim shows actual physical damage to one of the program's covered load-bearing elements that makes it unable to carry its load or makes the home unsafe, confirmed by an engineer when the program requires an engineer's evaluation of structural claims; damage from soil movement qualifies only when the program covers soil movement damage. | Not structural defect |
| 5 | The item is not among the program's items never covered as workmanship; mold damage is excluded unless the program covers mold damage, detached structures unless the program covers detached structures, and association common elements unless the program covers common elements. | Excluded item |
| 6 | The damage is not from the owner's alterations, neglect or failure to maintain drainage, which is excluded. | Owner caused |

**Timing of structural determinations.** Structural determinations are issued within the program's structural evaluation period, in calendar days, after filing.

## Applying the order

The reason recorded on a claim that is not covered is the reason of the earliest condition in the table that fails, even when later conditions fail too.

| Hypothetical claim | Conditions failing | Determination |
|---|---|---|
| All six conditions hold | None | Covered |
| Filed after the notice window; the item is also among those never covered as workmanship | 2 and 5 | Not covered — late notice |
| Defect discovered after its phase ended and outside the grace; filed within the notice window | 1 | Not covered — warranty not in force |
| A structural claim whose engineer's evaluation finds no load-bearing element unable to carry its load and the home not unsafe | 4 | Not covered — not structural defect |
| Damage traced to the owner's failure to maintain drainage, every earlier condition holding | 6 | Not covered — owner caused |

**Hypothetical measurement under a program whose drywall crack threshold is 0.125 inch.** A drywall crack measured at 0.10 inch is not wider than 0.125 inch; condition 3 fails, and if conditions 1 and 2 hold the claim is not covered — below performance standard.

**Hypothetical timing.** A structural claim filed on 2 April under a program whose structural evaluation period is 30 calendar days has its determination issued no later than 2 May.
